dedupe_keys.name: software reproducible results modeling spatiotemporal domestic wastewater variability implications for measuring treatment efficiency

description: Néstor DelaPaz-Ruíz and colleagues at the University of Twente publish a NetLogo simulation of domestic wastewater variability. Zenodo archives the reproduction software under CC BY 4.0; its linked repository describes code, data, R analysis, setup steps and optional Docker environments. Two NetLogo variants represent an uncalibrated and a calibrated, evaluated model. The associated journal article addresses how spatial and temporal variability affects the measurement of sanitation treatment efficiency. Modellers can compare sampling or treatment-efficiency scenarios once the local input data and calibration are understood. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is the paper’s study setup, not a generic wastewater network for all cities. A limitation is that the README specifies older NetLogo and RStudio versions, and its repository licence note says MIT while Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. The archive was not downloaded, Docker was not started, and no simulated series or published table was reproduced.
